# Walkers, shells-on-legs, swimmers.
# goomba (palette 3): 1 = black, 2 = cream, 3 = brown.
# koopa / paratroopa: 1 = shell green, 2 = white, 3 = yellow skin.
# buzzy beetle: 1 = shell, 2 = light, 3 = brown.   spiny: 1 = red, 2 = white, 3 = cream.
# bloober: 1 = black, 2 = white, 3 = grey.   cheep: 1 = body, 2 = white, 3 = cream.
